body:
From your Economy pick: the Market pays 10 each, farm goods only.
1. Talk to Mr. Bun: a Sell part on top, only when you have farm goods.
2. One row each: 🥚 Farm eggs, 🥛 Farm milk, how many, one Sell button for all.
3. Below it the normal Buy list. Coin sound as today.

comments.text: Approved: you decided it in Economy (31 Oct). Picture for reference.

short: The Market gets a Sell part for farm eggs and milk

title: Sell farm goods at the Market
